# Hostelworld

> > Hostelworld is a leading hostel booking platform providing secure infrastructure for file transfers and data management.

Hostelworld operates a secure file transfer system with SSO authentication for internal and partner data exchange. The platform emphasizes security and temporary storage solutions for sensitive file sharing operations.

## Key Topics

- Hostelworld
- File Transfer
- SSO Authentication
- Secure File Sharing
- Temporary Storage
- Data Security
- Login Systems
- Hostel Booking Platform
- File Management
- Access Control

## File Transfer & Security

- [Hostelworld File Transfer](https://filetransfer.hostelworld.com/): Secure file transfer platform with SSO authentication for exchanging files with temporary storage capabilities
